design.unit: tenant incarnation owns one IsolateVM security/accounting domain; multiple actors may live within it
design.memory: tenant-owned mutable state never crosses into another tenant; cross-tenant delivery copies or re-encodes values
design.actor_execution: no actor reentrancy, including across suspension or independent lock queues
design.resource_accounting: limit tenant admissions, per-tenant guest memory/actors and inflight work; account host overhead separately; the scalar reference turn is non-reentrant even if tenant inflight capacity exceeds one
design.failure: guest trap or unrecoverable execution error quarantines incarnation, disallows future calls and must retire its resources before reuse
design.capabilities: fail-closed denial of FFI, WASI, filesystem, network, native memory and host imports unless explicitly authorized
design.trust: logical heap/arena quotas are not physical security boundaries
design.untrusted: hostile tenant workloads need a proven runtime sandbox plus process/OS security enforcement; no silent backend downgrade
design.aot: signed/approved native artifacts required before any unsafe deserialization; caller-supplied SHA is only identity check
design.shutdown: fence queued/running work, drain references and resource loans, then reclaim; never resolve shutdown before physical retirement
design.root_authority: Opaque authority belongs to one root VM; matching tenant ID and numeric generation from another root never grants access
design.tenant_id_validation: ASCII [A-Za-z0-9_.-], 1..128 bytes, excluding reserved path components '.' and '..'; strings are identifiers, not filesystem paths

java.currentGuarantee: actor-owned arenas/context or shared VM do not prove separate physical heaps

llvm.draft: OresVM with native heap and process-mode fail-closed
llvm.currentGuarantee: TrustedInProcess is not native code sandbox

wasm.draft: Wasmtime Store + Instance per tenant in native AOT host
wasm.currentGuarantee: distinct Wasm linear memories in one process; not OS security

cranelift.draft: Rust Cranelift stage-0 scalar native JIT, actor lowering rejected
cranelift.currentGuarantee: not an actor IsolateVM or tenant heap and not safe for hostile source execution

net.currentGuarantee: not separate CLR heaps, AppDomains or OS processes

forge.draft: native actor mailbox and arena ownership
forge.currentGuarantee: not a tenant OS memory compartment

js.currentGuarantee: Workers are in-process, not hostile tenant OS sandbox

supersededReason: 2026-11-03 decision: hostile tenants share one OS process, one VM-isolate per tenant; a per-tenant process or OS sandbox is no longer required. v1 text below is kept as history.
